adGroupId.description: An identifier for an ad group.

budgetRecoverableVisualisation.description: Visualisation showing the amount of at-risk budget that can be recovered through recommendations.

atRisk.description: Amount of budget projected to be unspent by end of flight.

atRiskLabel.description: Translated label for the at-risk amount (e.g. "At Risk").

currency.description: Currency code of the budget values, e.g. USD.

recoverable.description: Amount of at-risk budget that can be recovered with recommendations.

recoverableLabel.description: Translated label for the recoverable amount (e.g. "Recoverable").

recoverablePercentLabel.description: Translated label for the recovery percentage (e.g. "92% recoverable").

canonicalId.description: An identifier for DSP advertising objects such as line item, order or advertiser Id.

category.description:
Category for the recommendation. Used for type-based grouping in the guidance panel:
 * `MAX_BID` - Recommendations to increase maximum average CPM
 * `FREQUENCY_CAP` - Recommendations to increase frequency cap
 * `VIEWABILITY` - Recommendations to lower viewability threshold
 * `AUDIENCES` - Recommendations to add recommended audiences
 * `SIMILAR_AUDIENCES` - Recommendations to enable similar audiences
 * `MISSING_CREATIVE` - Recommendations to add missing creative sizes
 * `OTHER` - Recommendations that do not fall into a specific category above
 * `REPAIR` - Deprecated
 * `DELIVERY` - Deprecated
 * `PERFORMANCE` - Deprecated
 * `BUDGET` - Deprecated
 * `RETAIL` - Deprecated
 * `TARGETING` - Deprecated
 * `BIDDING` - Deprecated

dateTime.description: A string representation of this instant formatted as ISO-8601.

dateTimeInstant.description: A string representation of this instant formatted as ISO-8601 cast to an Instant datatype.

dspObject.description: The DSP object to which the recommendation is related.

name.description: Name of the DSP object that is set by user during initialisation step.

execution.description: The execution done by QuickActions on the recommendation.

message.description: Generic message to be used for errors or omissions.

messageType.description: Type of message to be used for errors or omissions, which will be mapped to localised strings at the client side.

guidance.description: An object describing dynamically created guidance derived by the rule-based aggregation of individual recommendations.

cardTitle.description: Title text for the guidance card.

explainabilityStatus.description:
Indicates whether explainability can be requested for this guidance.
- SUPPORTED: explainability can be generated by calling GenerateGuidanceExplainability
- NOT_SUPPORTED: this guidance type does not support explainability generation

groupRecommendationsBy.description: Group recommendations according to this target in the UI

guidanceId.description: A unique identifier for guidance object.

parentGuidanceId.description: Identifier of a higher level guidance object.

prioritisationScore.description: Guidance prioritisation score based on aggregated recommendations to determine ranking of multiple guidance items among each other.

recommendations.description: List of dynamically aggregated recommendations used to generate this guidance.

tags.description: List of structured tags objects annotating the guidance.

targets.description: Objects targeted by this guidance depending on the aggregation level, including `ENTITY`, `ADVERTISER` and `ORDER`.

totalRecommendationCount.description: Total count of recommendations used to generate this guidance.

visualisation.description: Optional visual data to render alongside the guidance card.

label.description: Button or link label for call-to-action.

guidanceLineItemTarget.description: A line item targeted by guidance.

guidanceName.description: Identifier for a piece of guidance.

guidanceOrderFlightTarget.description: An order flight targeted by guidance.

guidanceTag.description: A structured type used to store additional metadata.

name.description: Optional display name of the guidance target.

guidanceType.description:
Guidance type for the recommendation whether it is an Alert or Opportunity:
 * `ALERT` - Guidance type for recommendations which are Alerts
 * `OPPORTUNITY` - Guidance type for recommendations which are Opportunities

language.description: Indicates a language and locale. If omitted, defaults to en-US.

adGroupIds.description: A list of ad group IDs.

listGuidanceRequestFilters.description: Optional filters to apply to generated guidance.

guidanceNames.description: Limit guidance to the specified guidance names. If unset, defaults to returning all guidance.

includeRecommendations.description:
Specify if individual recommendations should be included in the guidance response.
Useful to reduce response payload size. Does not affect `totalRecommendationCount`.

guidance.description: An array of objects describing dynamically created guidance derived by the rule-based aggregation of individual recommendations.

index.description: Array index referencing the target object in the request array.

totalGuidanceCount.description: Total count of guidance available for this target.

error.description: Error response containing error code and description associated with the target object, referenced by array index.

success.description: Success response containing guidance associated with the target object, referenced by array index.

index.description: Array index referencing the target object in the request array.

marketplaceId.description: The identifier of the marketplace to which the recommendation is associated with.

nextToken.description: Opaque pagination token returned in the query response to be provided in subsequent calls to retrieve paginated recommendations.

quickAction.description: An object describing the action associated with this recommendation.

actionType.description: String identifying the type of suggested action.

currentValue.description: Current setting value that triggered the recommendation.

recommendedValue.description: Recommended setting value to be applied by the Quick Action.

quickactionsData.description: The automated QuickAction object associated with the recommendation.

executionHistory.description: The history of existing QuickAction executions on this recommendation.

recommendation.description: An object describing the DSP recommendation generated to improve the campaign performance for display advertising.

expectedChanges.description: Expected changes are represented as a json array of arrays and are interpreted to be in a Disjunctive normal form (DNF).

targets.description: Nested list of lists used to group related objects targeted by this recommendation.

errorMessage.description: Detailed information about the error that occurred.

requestId.description: A unique value generated by the server to identify the request.

tableColumn.description: A single column to be rendered in the front-end.

width.description:
Column width ratio expressed as whole integer - does not necessarily add up to 100.
Ratio must be positive.

E.g. four columns with widths [20, 15, 50, 15] to be rendered as [20/100, 15/100, 50/100, 15/100] width
respectively or [2, 5, 2, 3] to be rendered as [2/12, 5/12, 2/12, 3/12].

target.description: An object targeted by a recommendation, e.g a Rodeo order.

displayName.description: Optional target display name, e.g. the Rodeo order name.

type.description: Type of the target, e.g. RODEO_ORDER.
Describes the purpose for the recommendation, for example DEPRECATED_AUDIENCE_REMOVAL

userStatus.description: Status for the recommendation set by user.

info.description: Provides guidance to improve performance and delivery of display advertising campaigns.
info.title: DSP Guidance

post.description:
**Authorized resource type**:
DSP Rodeo Entity ID, DSP Advertiser Account ID

**Parameter name**:
Amazon-Ads-AccountId

**Parameter in**:
header

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["campaign_view"]

parameters.description: Optionally specify the content locale, such as DSP Language of Preference. If omitted, defaults to `en-US`.
parameters.name: Accept-Language

parameters.description: The identifier of a client associated with a "Login with Amazon" account.
parameters.name: Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId

parameters.description: Account identifier you use to access the DSP. This is your Amazon DSP Advertiser ID.
parameters.name: Amazon-Ads-AccountId

parameters.description: The identifier of a profile associated with the advertiser account. Use GET method on Profiles resource to list profiles associated with the access token passed in the HTTP Authorization header.
parameters.name: Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope

requestBody.description:
Targets are ad groups to list guidance for.
The request can include optional filters to exclude individual recommendations from the guidance response when not needed to reduce the response payload size.

200.description: List of guidance for the specified ad groups.

401.description: Unauthorised access to the requested DSP entity identifier.

post.summary:
Retrieves a list of dynamically generated guidance based on recommendations present for a list of ad groups specified in the request body.
This can include guidance to correct campaign setup errors, address underdelivery or underperformance issues or adopt Amazon-recommended best practices.
